exec: pm.test('Simulated payment amount and status', () => {const t=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(t.status).to.eql('succeeded'); pm.expect(t.paymentMethod).to.eql('simulated'); pm.expect(t.amountCents).to.eql(400000); });

pm.test('Correct earnings and transaction history', () => {const d=pm.response.json().data; pm.expect(d.totalIncomeCents).to.be.at.least(400000); pm.expect(d.completedPayments).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(d.transactions.some(t=>t.booking===pm.environment.get('bookingId'))).to.eql(true); });
